name: ATM
summary: Freestanding room-scale cash machine with screen, keypad, card and cash slots; unbranded, for street and bank scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the machine stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: at s = 1 about 1000 px tall and 580 px wide; use about 0.5 for a smaller scene

params.name: anim
params.note: screen = menu highlight moves down the rows and the card LED blinks
